senses.gloss:
Aurabhra
ancient authority on med. ref. to in Suśrutasaṁhitā a. a disciple of Dhanvantari (I. 3) an. writer on surgery (IV. 9). Also q. in Tīsaṭa's C. on Candraṭa's Cikitsākalikā (See Oxf. 358a). Ind. q. 10 verses from Urabhra in his C. on Aṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha (Ed.. Trichur, 1914-20). Q. also in Yogaratnasamuccaya of Anantakumāra, TSS. 152. II. 90. 96. 243. 250. 253. 300. 368. 430.

Aurasaputranirūpaṇa
dh. by Vaidyanātha. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 14.
